settings.title: Settings
settings.ownerOnly: Only the streamer and people with full control can change these settings.
settings.modeDescription: You decide. You can always change it, and what is already uploaded stays as it is.

owner.name: Only me
owner.description: Only you and people with full control upload emotes.

staff.name: Me and my moderators
staff.description: Also the moderators with access to your panel. This is the starting mode.

approval.name: Anyone, with review
approval.description: Any viewer with an account uploads an emote that stays pending until you approve it. People on your allowed list publish directly.

list.name: Only my list
list.description: Only you, your moderators and the people on your allowed list.

settings.maxPendingHint: How many emotes from the same person can wait for review at once.
settings.uploadersDescription: They upload directly, without review, in the «Anyone, with review» and «Only my list» modes.
settings.publicDescription: Your community sees the emotes here and, if you allow it, uploads their own. Share it in your chat or description.
settings.shownInOverlayHint: Active emotes always show in the chat overlay. They can be turned off from that overlay's Emotes tab.
